metaDescription: Reach the JIE calibration lab in Belgaum and the Hubli branch: phone numbers, emails, addresses and Google Maps directions. Enquire on WhatsApp.
intro: The quickest way to reach JIE is WhatsApp — the gold button opens a chat with the enquiry ready to send. Phone and email work just as well for the calibration lab in Belgaum and the branch office in Hubli.
Opening hours and any other contact channels have not been published, so they are not listed here.
officesIntro: Addresses exactly as printed in the company's documents. The main calibration laboratory is in Udyambag, Belgaum; the branch office is in Hubli.

gstinNote: Goods and Services Tax identification number of the business.
whatsappText: Tell us what needs calibration, repair or supply and the enquiry goes straight to the team on WhatsApp.
serviceMessage: Hello JIE, I would like to know more about your calibration and repair services.
closingTitle: We look forward to hearing from you!
closingText: Reach out today — the buttons above connect straight to the team, and the addresses are where the work happens.
